Disciples of Mohist Gate are required to submit a craftsmanship thesis weekly, which will be automatically published every Monday to earn a certain amount of Research Value.
A disciple's weekly Research Value and Reputation together contribute to their sect's internal merit ranking.
In addition to individual submissions, participating in fellow disciples' thesis research can also grant a portion of the subsequent Research Value added to the thesis:
When both master and apprentice are Mohist Hill Disciples, the master will receive 25% of the apprentice's weekly thesis Research Value.
Becoming a co-author of another's thesis grants 25% of the collaborator's weekly thesis Research Value.
